text_block_list.text:
On a rest day during summer training camp,
Mejiro Bright headed out in the morning, saying she was going to hang out with Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.
"Word is they're planning to head out to a resort area a little ways away."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'm super confident
in today's leisure plan! Let's enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, my goodness～

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... It's so hot...
But I can't let myself burn out before arriving...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry at all, Lady Tsuru-chan~
We've set aside pl~enty of travel time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have already scouted out the perfect shop for a break.
Allow me to guide you~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So deeelicious!!
This 'Triple Special Frozen' has waves of all kinds of flavors crashing in!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu... My mouth is just overflowing with pure happiness~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Should I choose accessories or decorations...?
Oh, but Lady McQueen also loves sweets, doesn't she...?
My, it is so hard to decide~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Bright-san. You'll have plenty of time
to agonize over souvenirs after our island cruise.
We'll be back by evening, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"So for now, let's head to the dock.
I've already purchased the boarding tickets online."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was indeed the case~.
Well then, let us be on our way~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Bright-san, I'm taking the photo now!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, perfect! Now then, there are still plenty of pretty spots—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
This is... such a lovely place.
Time seems to flow so slowly...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to bask in this a while longer.
Surrounded by the chirping birds and rustling trees..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Together with Lady Tsuru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa... Come to think of it... normally,
it would be about time for tea~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Sweet tea cakes and snacks...
We don't have those on remote islands, after all~...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
..................Hehehe.
A weekend teatime...
You really do love those, Bright-san...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I prepared for just such an occasion...!
I have! Prepared! Cookies!
...Though the drinks are just bottled ones."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...♪ That's our Tsuru-chan-sama for you~.
When it comes to tea, there is no need to worry whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I never expected them to bring
their own drink along with the cup...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, with this lovely weather, making sure Lady Tsuru stays hydrated is more important than ever~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“How should I put it... if we both noticed,
maybe next time we should decide on this before heading out.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
That is truly the case, isn't it~

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi & Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —And with that, I thoroughly enjoyed myself~.
I heard all about today's events from Mejiro Bright and the others. Just looking at their expressions made it abundantly clear that they had a fulfilling day off.
choice_data_list: As long as you two had fun, that's what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Well, of course. When the two of us hang out together, there's no way we wouldn't have fun, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~. After all, for us, this is the very best way.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Relaxed and easygoing, without pushing ourselves too hard. Right, Bright-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Right, Tsuru-chan-sama~.
Keep a re~laxed rhythm~.

"So this unique rhythm is indeed
the true charm of Mejiro Bright."
Watching the two of them laugh together warmed my heart as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about anyone else, but...
I've been doing it this way just fine for a long time now!
Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That it is♪
I see. This relaxed, heartwarming rhythm must suit their relationship perfectly. Watching the two of them laugh together, that thought crossed my mind.

Such a gentle personality that puts everyone at ease
is sure to be a great match for Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let us always stay on terms like these, shall we~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: We haven't been roommates for this long for nothing, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We need only continue to enjoy our ordinary days
in peace and tranquility♪
